headline: Philippine stocks drop to lowest level since April 2020 on growth concerns
summary: The Philippine Stock Exchange Index fell to its lowest point since April 2020 as concerns over domestic economic growth weighed on investor sentiment.
why: The Philippine Stock Exchange Index tracks the performance of primary publicly traded companies in the Philippines.

impacts.name: PSEi
impacts.why: Widespread macroeconomic growth concerns prompted domestic stock selling.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Persistent economic growth concerns triggered sustained equity sell-offs, driving benchmark stocks to multi-year lows.
